0022600166.text: The Timberwolves (4-2, third in the Northwest and sixth in the West) host the Bucks (1-4, 13th in the East) in Minnesota's eighth game of the season, with Minnesota coming off a win and Milwaukee coming off a loss. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Rudy Gobert (out, back spasms). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 139-106 win in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
